title: LoomCanvasCollectionViewsAndWorkspaceParity
clause: Restore Loom canvas and table, kanban, calendar and gallery collection views as canonical projections over SurrealDB records.

current_source_discovery: Inspect stable-main Loom canvas, block collection, table, kanban, calendar and gallery models/routes/UI/tests.
Identify shared-canvas collision history and exact ownership boundaries before implementation.
stop_conditions: A view would own a second copy of domain data.
Canvas identity or specialized domain projection ownership is ambiguous.

scope.summary: Make Loom's workspace views useful for IDE and creative projects while keeping them as query/layout projections. Specialized module canvases may adapt into Loom but cannot clobber shared Loom canvas state.
forbidden_paths: One canvas record reused incompatibly by Loom and a domain module
acceptance_criteria: Canvas nodes, edges, groups, viewport and layout revisions persist as project-qualified Surreal records referencing canonical Loom/domain identities.
Table, kanban, calendar and gallery views store typed view definitions while rows/cards/events/assets are derived from canonical records and relations.
Filters, grouping, sorting, pagination and drag/reorder produce deterministic atomic updates with conflict handling and restart parity.
Specialized domain canvases use explicit projection adapters and separate layout identities; no update can clobber another canvas type.
Native views expose empty/loading/conflict/denied/degraded states, keyboard navigation and stable Argus identifiers at representative sizes.
proof_targets: Run real-Surreal canvas/view persistence, conflict, query and restart tests.
Run collision regression proving specialized and shared canvases remain isolated.
Run Argus captures for table, kanban, calendar, gallery and canvas layouts including narrow/large states.

same_project_private_resource_cases: Shared view definitions do not reveal private rows or canvas nodes.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Rows/cards/events/gallery items inherit canonical source scope.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Open views requery and remove revoked items without retaining stale previews.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: Imported layouts do not import authority or grants.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Column values, group counts, calendar occupancy, thumbnails and positions do not reveal denied data.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.evidence: view/canvas create, mutate, conflict, deny and recovery events
query, layout, conflict and projection health
render/freeze/crash state and reproducible recovery handles

risk_if_missed: Creative and IDE users lose the visual organization layer, or specialized modules corrupt shared Loom canvas state.

risks: A view becomes a second data store.
Two canvas types share an identity and overwrite each other.
Private rows leak through counts or positions.
minimum_controls: Bounded rendering and Argus stress matrix.

research_provenance.selected_approach: Typed Surreal layout/view definitions over canonical records with isolated specialized projection adapters.
rejected_options: Shared mutable canvas identity across domains
